question: Should automatic DeepSeek Chrome local-storage discovery use a new shared browser host API, or is this provider-specific importer an approved host implementation and consent exception?
rationale: Repository architecture prohibits provider-owned browser-internals access, but the desired multi-profile local-storage capability is not covered by the existing documented browser API; permanent ownership of that boundary requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Add shared host API
options.body: Introduce a narrow browser-local-storage session API with explicit consent and move DeepSeek discovery behind it.

options.title: Approve scoped exception
options.body: Designate this importer as an approved host implementation and document its consent, filesystem, decryption, logging, and token-lifetime guarantees.

options.title: Keep manual sessions
options.body: Retain API-key balance and manually supplied Platform-session enrichment without automatic Chrome discovery.

recommendation.title: Add shared host API
recommendation.body: Introduce a narrow browser-local-storage session API with explicit consent and move DeepSeek discovery behind it.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice changes the repository's documented provider/host security boundary and therefore belongs with the repository owner.
